meta_description: 108 likes, 14 comments - mashable on October 28, 2026: "While the iPhone Duo has been mostly showered with praise on its launch day, there has been some criticism of the device.   Just hours after the iPhone Duo was released, some users are going home to find what appears to be a major defect that makes those previous critiques pale in comparison.   The problem? The inner display of the iPhone Duo is cracking from top to bottom along the entire hinge — right where the device folds — for some very unlucky first-day iPhone Duo users.  Apple will undoubtedly fix the issue for unlucky customers, but it’s certainly a big launch-day inconvenience for the first iPhone Duo owners. ".
